text: Artificial intelligence, or AI, is the ability of computers to perform tasks that normally require human intelligence, such as understanding language or making decisions. Machine learning is a key part of AI: instead of following fixed rules, computers learn from data and improve with experience. Deep learning takes this further by using large artificial neural networks to recognise patterns in images, speech, and text. AI is already part of daily life. It recommends films on streaming services, helps maps find the fastest route, powers voice assistants on smartphones, and filters spam from our email. In short, AI is changing how we live and work.
